meta.name: han-feedback
meta.description: Capture structured feedback on the Han skills and agents used in the current session and optionally post it as a GitHub issue to testdouble/han. Use at the end of any session where one or more han-* skills or agents ran, to rate a run, log what worked and what didn't, or submit observations for maintainers. Does not review code, investigate bugs, or research options; use code-review, investigate, or research for those. Does not provide feedback on skills or agents from non-Han plugins.

copy.tagline: 记录对当前会话中技能和助手的评价并提交反馈。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 Han 技能后想给维护者留下结构化反馈。
